meta.note: Sequence: BASE-001 → 002 → 003 → 004 (foundation) → 005 (reference) → 006 (master) → 007 (inventory) → 008 (state) → 009 (tests) → 010 (process). Parallel where deps allow.

queue.name: Semantic Data Type & Precision Convention
queue.why: All money/qty/price fields need this. Wrong precision → financial audit failure. Already seeded in MDM-000D R1.

queue.name: Numbering Convention
queue.why: Document numbers are business identity. Need UNIQUE constraint + tenant scope + ResetPolicy.
queue.deliverable: NumberSequence entity, UNIQUE constraint, ResetPolicy enum, manual number support

queue.name: Parameter Scope Convention
queue.why: Settings must be scoped SYSTEM/TENANT/COMPANY/PLANT. Wrong scope = data leak.

queue.name: Foundation Cross-Cutting Convention
queue.why: SnowflakeId + ConcurrencyVersion + AuditLog + DesignLog + SoftDelete + AggregateState. Each is small; together they prevent re-inventing in each module.

queue.name: UOM + Currency + Tax (Master Reference Data)
queue.why: UOM (P0-05) + Currency (P0-06) + Tax (P0-07) are all cross-module master data. Need dimension metadata, ISO 4217, inclusive/exclusive tax.

queue.name: BusinessPartner + Item + Category (Master Data)
queue.why: BP (P0-09) + Item (P0-10) + Category are shared across modules. Code formats, address/contact structure, type taxonomy.

queue.name: Warehouse + Location + InventoryStatus
queue.why: Inventory core. WarehousePolicy per Plant, LocationType, InventoryStatus 5-state balance.

queue.name: Document State Machine Library
queue.why: Reusable state machine for SO/PO/GR/MO/QC. POC-003 has it for SO; need to generalize.

queue.name: Field-Level Comment Obligation + Architecture Tests
queue.why: Cheap now, hard to retrofit. pg_description on every column. ArchUnit test for invariants.
queue.deliverable: pg_description convention, ArchUnit tests, run in CI

queue.name: Discovery Preflight Checklist (Process)
queue.why: Document common ERP gotchas (DEV-derived) for future goals to review pre-kickoff. Prevents P0-15 class of issues.
queue.deliverable: docs/process/PREFLIGHT_ERP_GOTCHAS.md, applied to next goal kickoff
